summary: Li Auto Inc., via Form 6-K filing exhibits, disclosed daily share repurchase activity under Hong Kong listing rules. On August 31, 2026, the issuer repurchased 597,500 Class A ordinary shares at an average price of HKD 47.8124 per share, representing 0.0346% of issued shares, bringing total issued shares to approximately 1.818 billion and treasury shares to 92.25 million. Four Next Day Disclosure Returns cover buybacks from August 31 to September 3, 2026. These open-market repurchases are part of Li Auto's capital return program, reducing outstanding float. Watch for continued repurchase disclosures and potential cancellation of treasury shares.
